criteria.requirement: Implement tablib.loading.load_records(records,columns,*,aliases=None,missing="raise",extra="raise",converters=None,errors="raise",title=None) returning completed ConversionResult. Output column order is explicit; aliases map output names to unique external keys. Validate missing raise/none and extra raise/ignore, consume mapping records once and detach values. Use actual Dataset.dict loading with canonical header prototype while retaining each later mapping order, requiring completed alignment repair; remove prototype before output. Compose actual convert_columns, preserve false/zero/empty/None, support empty input, fail without partial output and never mutate incoming records.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
